name: 06608 · Bridgeport, CT
findings: ZIP 06608 (Bridgeport) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06608 (Bridgeport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06608 (Bridgeport) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
